hints.tr: `if let Poll::Ready(value) = Pin::new(&mut this.a).poll(cx) { return Poll::Ready(Either::Left(value)); }`
hints.en: `if let Poll::Ready(value) = Pin::new(&mut this.a).poll(cx) { return Poll::Ready(Either::Left(value)); }`

tests.code: let r = block_on(Select { a: std::future::ready(1), b: std::future::pending::<u8>() }); assert_eq!(r, Either::Left(1));
let r = block_on(Select { a: std::future::pending::<u8>(), b: std::future::ready(2) }); assert_eq!(r, Either::Right(2));
let r = block_on(Select { a: std::future::ready(1), b: std::future::ready(2) }); assert_eq!(r, Either::Left(1));

let a = std::rc::Rc::new(()); let keep = a.clone(); let loser = Box::pin(async move { let _k = keep; std::future::pending::<()>().await; }); let mut race = Select { a: loser, b: std::future::ready(()) }; assert_eq!(std::rc::Rc::strong_count(&a), 2); let r = Pin::new(&mut race).poll(&mut Context::from_waker(Waker::noop())); assert!(matches!(r, Poll::Ready(Either::Right(())))); drop(race); assert_eq!(std::rc::Rc::strong_count(&a), 1);
